cues.text: Welcome to the physics fundamentals lab. We will take the big ideas of physics one at a time. Each one starts with a concept card. Then you predict, watch the experiment, and explain it in your own words.
First, kinematics and vectors. Watch the car on the circular track, and keep an eye on its odometer and its arrows.
Now dynamics and impulse. You have carts on an air track, a Newton's cradle and an egg drop tower. Predict before every run.
Next, work, energy and power. Push the crate, swing the pendulum and run the winch, and watch where the energy goes.
Welcome to the measurement bench. Thermometer, stopwatch, balances and rulers: measure carefully, and predict before you read.
Prediction locked. Now run it and see what really happens.
That is not what you predicted, and that is fine. Surprises are where the learning happens. Think about why.
That is every question on every bench. Open your summary to see how your predictions and explanations went.
